caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average accuracy of different training methods across 11 datasets. The horizontal axis represents the training methods, labeled as "Standard", "Self-RAG", "FactTuneClnGS (w/)", and "ClnGS". The vertical axis, “Average Performance”, displays accuracy values on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Four bars, each with a different color, correspond to the four training methods. The shortest bar, representing the "Standard" training method, has an approximate height of 20, while the tallest bar, corresponding to "ClnGS”, reaches approximately 58. The remaining bars representing "Self-RAG" and "FactTuneClnGS (w/)" have approximate heights of 52 and 50, respectively.  The bars are generally arranged in ascending order of height, with "Standard" being the shortest and "ClnGS" the tallest. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
